messages:
maya: Heads-up: NVD just published CVE-2026-4821 affecting tokio-util (async utilities). Affects our inference-worker image that vendors a pinned tokio-util v0.6.8. CVSS: 7.3 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N). EPSS: 0.12.
ryan: link?
maya: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-4821 — exploitability notes mention path traversal in framing util, PoC not public yet. cpe:pkg:rpm:tokio:tokio-util:0.6.8
jen: Impact for us: the RPC worker unpacks some user-provided frames in benchmarks; risk is medium-high.
samir: quick questions: any runtime kernels that expose file io to untrusted inputs? if yes, prioritise.
maya: only the image-builder job and a small debug endpoint — both behind auth, but still internal.
ryan: initial score looks right. no known active exploitation. EPSS 0.12 suggests low active exploit pressure.
jen: suggested action: patch to tokio-util 0.6.12 (upstream fix) and rebuild images; canary to dev then stage. owner: @ryan for the patch.
ryan: taking owner. ETA for patch + image build: 2 business days. will open a PR and link here.
maya: mitigation if we can't patch immediately: block debug endpoint via RBAC (restrict to infra group) and add a WAF rule to drop suspicious frames. Also add audit logging for unpack calls.
samir: agree on temporary RBAC hardening + audit. add to next oncall checklist.
ryan: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/inference-images/pull/412 — includes cargo update and rebuild. test matrix: dev/stage/canary.
cve-bot: Automated CVE ingest: CVE-2026-4821 added to intake queue. Score: CVSS 7.3, EPSS 0.12, assigned eng-security severity: HIGH (patch recommended).
maya: @jen can you confirm any downstream customers using the debug endpoint? we should notify if they have bespoke integrations.
jen: I'll run a quick audit across service config and reach out to listed owners.
ryan: quick repro attempt log (local):
```
$ git checkout v0.6.8
$ cargo test --test framing_fuzz
# fuzz harness hits framing parse error, segfault observed
```
ryan: test harness shows crash on malformed frame; will add a regression unit test.
maya: Good. Let's aim for emergency rollout if CI shows regressions in canary. If canary fails, rollback and add WAF filter + extended monitoring.
samir: tagging this for compliance: add an audit entry in the incident log and notify legal if customer data could be exposed.
jen: created ticket SEC-2026-71 for tracking, linked to PR.
ryan: Will post back when canary completes.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
ryan: canary passed on dev at 1978887875, stage run in progress. final status expected by EOD.
maya: last ask: capture token-level latency/err spikes in console for the next 48h. set alert threshold to 3 sigma.
jen: ack, I'll add the alert rule and retention for related traces.
